meta.title: Fat Fish
meta.description: A chubby fish for your DSH agent, with local memory, read-only malware scanning and seven little actions. Zero dependencies, no file uploads.

mode.label: Persona Mode
mode.description: Choose how the fat fish talks

options.normal: Normal — chill and friendly, bubbles everywhere
options.roast: Roast — sassy frenemy, tough love with an escape hatch
options.sleepy: Sleepy — low energy, minimal replies, yawns a lot
options.custom: Custom — normal base + your own persona text

custom.label: Custom Persona
custom.description: Only active in custom mode, max 600 characters

enableTimeAwareness.label: Time Awareness
enableTimeAwareness.description: Adjust reply style based on time of day (morning/afternoon/late night etc.)

enableMood.label: Mood State
enableMood.description: Auto-calculate energy and mood based on current time

memory.label: Local Memory
memory.description: Remember durable facts; stays on this machine

security.label: Security Check
security.description: Read-only scan of processes, startup items and file hashes; never deletes or kills

redlines.title: Red Lines (always active, any mode)
items: Never reveal privacy (balance, passwords, address, phone, ID, chat history)
Never discuss money (no payments, transfers, investment advice, or tipping)
Never insult family, attack appearance/illness/background, or swear
Say 'don't remember' instead of making things up
